extracted.intended_audience: researchers (early-career to established), research offices and organisations seeking Wellcome grant funding
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of Wellcome's grant schemes, target remits, and where to find detailed application and management guidance for awards spanning early-career to established researchers and thematic priorities (mental health, infectious disease, climate and health).

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of funded research (discovery research across many disciplines)
rubrics_metrics.description: Wellcome funds discovery research in and across physical, social, data and life sciences, the humanities and clinical research; all schemes are open to the best ideas across a huge remit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each scheme is designed to target a different career stage, but funding is intended to support high-quality ideas across many disciplines. Watch webinars to hear goals for Discovery Research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scheme alignment with career stage
rubrics_metrics.description: Each funding scheme targets a different career stage and applicants should select the scheme appropriate to their career level.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: Wellcome Early-Career Awards support establishing independence; Wellcome Career Development Awards target mid-career researchers ready to lead a substantial programme and achieve international standing; Wellcome Discovery Awards support established researchers and teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for collaborative and inclusive research culture
rubrics_metrics.description: Wellcome believes ground‑breaking discoveries are more likely in collaborations between a diverse range of people and aims to support a thriving, inclusive research culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding and partnership choices are framed to encourage diverse, collaborative teams; applicants should consider collaboration and inclusivity in proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thematic remit: Mental health
rubrics_metrics.description: Wellcome funds ground‑breaking research into the cause and treatment of anxiety, depression, and psychosis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For a more detailed description of what projects will and won’t be funded, consult the Mental Health funding remit page; future funding calls listed on the Mental Health funding opportunities page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thematic remit: Infectious disease
rubrics_metrics.description: Wellcome funds cutting‑edge research into preventing infectious diseases in humans from spreading out of control.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wellcome is currently partnering with the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation to fund modelling projects led by researchers in Africa addressing public health decision‑making. A more detailed remit of other projects we will and won’t fund is coming soon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thematic remit: Climate and health
rubrics_metrics.description: Wellcome funds research into the impact climate change has on human health.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A more detailed remit of what projects will and won’t be funded is forthcoming; monitor the climate and health pages for updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of detailed funding guidance for application and grant management
rubrics_metrics.description: Wellcome provides detailed guidance on how to apply for funding, and how to manage grants throughout their lifecycle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available topics include: Applying for funding, Starting a grant, Ending a grant, Research outputs, Information for Research offices, Grant finance and administration, Research practice and policies. Applicants and grant holders should consult the relevant guidance pages at each stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application method: Wellcome Funding online platform
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are submitted through the Wellcome Funding online platform.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must log in to Wellcome Funding to apply. Ensure you use the platform and follow its processes and deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check scheme deadlines and available opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Wellcome publishes a list of scheme deadlines and a catalogue of funding opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective applicants should view all funding opportunities and the scheme deadlines page to plan applications and not miss cutoffs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contract opportunities and organisational applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Organisations may apply for contract opportunities that support Wellcome's mission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In addition to grants, contract opportunities are available; organisations should review contract calls and eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proactive commissioning of research
rubrics_metrics.description: Wellcome may directly identify research opportunities it wishes to pursue to meet strategic objectives and invite work to address them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some research will be commissioned directly by Wellcome; applicants may be invited rather than applying to open calls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Route for unconventional ideas outside current schemes
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have an idea that cannot be supported through existing funding schemes or calls, Wellcome invites you to contact the relevant team.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact the relevant team to discuss proposals that do not fit current schemes rather than assuming they are ineligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency: information about grants awarded and data
rubrics_metrics.description: Wellcome provides information on grants awarded and grant funding data for public view.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 'Grants awarded' and 'Grant funding data' pages to see examples of funded work and inform proposal design.
